🏎️ Assetto Corsa Rally just dropped its biggest update of 2026!

Update 0.7 adds the twin-charged Lancia Delta S4 Group B (1986) and the modern Evo2 Italtecnica build, plus a massive new Rally Sweden location — over 30km of laser-scanned snow stages across two sites (Vargåsen & Fredriksberg), with full day-night cycles, Northern Lights, dynamic weather and mandatory studded snow tyres.

Also new: a 16-player Online Rally Weekend multiplayer mode, updated handling across every car and surface (with input from WRC driver Jon Armstrong), and support for Intel XeSS 3 upscaling.

🕐 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 11:57 GMT+3

📰 Sources: Inven Global, GamesPress

Got a favorite rally stage, or trying the new Delta S4? Tell us below! 👇
